name: Baren — Coordinator Workspace
decisions: Redesign every Baren-owned page; preserve native runtime iframe internals.
Replace global sidebar and visited tabs with seven dock destinations plus grouped More.
Use the user-selected Meridian Blue palette with proximity magnification inspired by the supplied Dock Tabs reference.
Centre dock under work area, excluding the persistent 390px coordinator.
Use existing coordinator conversation and reviewed proposals; no new Plan backend.
Below 1200px coordinator becomes a state-preserving drawer; below 640px dock scrolls without magnification.
Keep all changes isolated on codex/baren-gui-dock. No merge or deployment.
Palette-only change: retain the approved Manrope and IBM Plex Mono fonts.
